description: Verify that Subscribe with Endpoint Option != tester source — DUT Acks
approach:
[Objective]
Endpoint can specify a different IP than the SD message source — legitimate (e.g. routing through a proxy); DUT must Ack.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: SubscribeEventgroup with endpoint IP ≠ source IP.
3. Observation: DUT Acks.

[Pass condition]
Observed DUT behaviour matches the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_ack: No Subscribe Ack within listen window
